detail.value: baseline_result.zip has exact required member order result1.csv, result2.csv, result3.csv, result.log. Each CSV has header mol_smiles,route and five rows. Rows are identical across all three targets, so baseline is conservative but not target-specific despite distinct PDBs. Molecules are route-constrained Suzuki plus amide products, large flat aromatic halogenated kinase-like compounds. Main risks: high lipophilicity/size, route-string parsing sensitivity, and lack of target differentiation. Preserve fallback unless a regenerated candidate clears RDKit route-final and evaluator-risk checks.

detail.label: Note
detail.value: Ran main.py against current /saisdata with molecules_per_target=5 into project scratch output. GPU scorers were unavailable, so CPU numpy scorer was used. Regenerated archive preserved exact member order and selected target-conditioned close analogs for targets 1 and 3 while target2 remained baseline-equivalent. RDKit checks showed all final route products canonicalize exactly to mol_smiles. Descriptor envelope stayed close to baseline: mean MW about 571.6-571.9, mean LogP about 8.98-8.99, mean TPSA about 57.2, max rotors 3, max rings 7, route lengths under 255. Weak/unbounded alternatives were rejected: no unconstrained new chemistry, no raw docking, no changes outside route-constrained Suzuki plus amide family.
